subject: The NDTV World Summit and a speech full of 'Congress'
alt: Cartoon: on a stage under a pale violet sky, a speaker with a white beard and glasses spreads both arms and smiles as he talks. Behind and above him the whole sky is filled with one word written over and over: 'Congress' (in Hindi). His podium reads 'NDTV World Summit 2026: A World Between Orders'. Bottom right, two silhouettes whisper to each other: 'Has Congress sponsored his speech?'
chutki: The stage is for a discussion of a turbulent world, and the podium says as much: a world between orders. But the whole sky behind the speaker is filled with a single word, Congress, Congress, Congress. Small letters, big letters, thick and thin, as if the word had become the very air of the speech, and the speaker smiles with his arms spread wide in it.

Dhodapkar's jab sits in the whisper of the two listeners below. When one name keeps coming up in a speech, again and again, the listener begins to suspect that the name itself must have sponsored it. Only someone who has listened to the whole speech closely would ask.
